**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 7.2, p0026).**

- **Issue:** § 7.2 runs an MFN against us — before engaging another provider, Juniper Ridge must disclose and match for Cobalt any more favourable commercial offer it receives. It is unbounded as to product, duration, and comparison methodology, so it fails the fallback (defined product, 12 months, reasonable-comparison carve-outs) and lands in walk-away territory.
- **Conflict:** § 12.3 has Vendor expressly acknowledge that Customer has made no exclusivity or most-favoured-customer commitment, so § 7.2 is also internally inconsistent.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** delete § 7.2 entirely. No Vendor-granted MFN exists in the document, so nothing beneficial to us is lost; there is no separate exclusivity covenant, so the term is flagged once here rather than double-counted.
